notes: macros-cache.txt is what the client last wrote; the server can replace it at login when macro sync is on. In a real capture (docs/LAB_FORMATS.md, 2026-10-16) a macro made in a finished session was missing from it (whether the client rewrites it at logout is [verify]), so a macro may be missing here, or still listed after you deleted it.

The spellbook and action bars are the lab-addon's record as of its last save (logout or /reload), not the session in progress. It reads the player's spellbook only, so an item, a pet, mount or toy spell after /cast reads as not in the spellbook.
